title: Members of the Korean Constabulary March to Song in Jeju-Do, Korea
partOf: NARA › RG 342 › Photographs of Activities, Facilities, and Personnel
summary: Original caption: KOREAN CONSTABULARY MARCHES TO SONG - Trained under the U. S. Military Government, the Korean constabulary is proving an efficient, well-disciplined organization. Picture shows a group marching to duty in Kangnung, Korea. They always march to their own songs, which sometimes resemble fierce shouts.
